subject.title: feat(auth): support configurable session cookie names

question: Should ClickClack support `CLICKCLACK_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME` as a public server setting and expose the effective name through the desktop OAuth consume contract?
rationale: This introduces permanent authentication configuration and a cross-version desktop/server API contract; code review alone cannot determine whether maintainers want to support that surface long term.

options.title: Accept after proof
options.body: Approve the setting and response field after the contributor demonstrates the packaged desktop custom-cookie flow and documents the client-version boundary.

options.title: Limit to browser sessions
options.body: Accept server/browser cookie isolation but defer desktop support until a separately designed compatibility mechanism is approved.

options.title: Decline the setting
options.body: Keep the fixed cookie contract and require separate hostnames for independently deployed instances.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof
recommendation.body: Approve the setting and response field after the contributor demonstrates the packaged desktop custom-cookie flow and documents the client-version boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available routing candidate for a project-wide authentication configuration and desktop contract decision.
